name: Reed-Cloister Adept

abilities.name: Patient Defense
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the reed-cloister adept takes the Dodge action.

abilities.name: Cunning Action
abilities.description: As a bonus action, the reed-cloister adept takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The reed-cloister adept makes two attacks: one with its Unarmed Strike and one with its Dart.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (6d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. Once on each of the reed-cloister adept's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the reed-cloister adept's next turn.

actions.name: Dart
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (4d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dart Volley (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 60 feet must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

generation.userConcept: a reed-cloister adept who flings darts and strikes unarmed

other_edition.lore: Raised in a cloister of stilt-huts amid the marsh reeds, the adept defends that ground with nothing but discipline and a handful of sharpened darts.
